scriptLines: query: 'SELECT a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk, dp.paciente_key, dd.departamento_key, COALESCE(dg.diagnostico_key, nd.diagnostico_key) AS diagnostico_key, (YEAR(a.admission_date)*10000+MONTH(a.admission_date)*100+DAY(a.admission_date)) AS fecha_ingreso_key, CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (YEAR(a.discharge_date)*10000+MONTH(a.discharge_date)*100+DAY(a.discharge_date)) END AS fecha_alta_key, a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id, DATEDIFF(DAY,a.admission_date,a.discharge_date) AS dias_estancia, 1 AS conteo_admisiones FROM silver.admissions a JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp ON dp.patient_id_bk=a.patient_id JOIN gold.dim_departamento dd ON dd.nombre_departamento=a.department OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 d.icd_code, d.severity, d.diagnosis_description FROM silver.diagnoses d WHERE d.admission_id=a.admission_id ORDER BY CASE d.severity WHEN \'Critical\' THEN 4 WHEN \'Severe\' THEN 3 WHEN \'Moderate\' THEN 2 WHEN \'Mild\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, d.diagnosis_id) dx LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dg ON dg.codigo_icd=dx.icd_code AND dg.nivel_severidad=ISNULL(dx.severity,\'Desconocida\') AND ISNULL(dg.descripcion_patologia,\'\')=ISNULL(dx.diagnosis_description,\'\') CROSS JOIN (SELECT diagnostico_key FROM gold.dim_diagnostico WHERE codigo_icd=\'N/D\') nd',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DBCC CHECKIDENT (\'gold.fact_admisiones\', RESEED, 0)'],
